The visualization-only DecisionTreeRegressor now fits on x_train, so it no longer crashes on raw text columns. No overlap found. Test accuracy is ~0.79 (no fixed seed).

Removed it and now fill xtrain/xtest with train-only means right after train_test_split (cell 32). Also fixed an evaluation bug: model.score(xtest, pred)->model.score(xtest, ytest) (it always returned 1.0). Accuracy is now 0.9842.

(2) Missed by tool: random KFold split players of the same match across train/valid; switched to GroupKFold(10) by matchId. (3) Missed by tool: early stopping used the scored validation fold; it now uses a separate 10% GroupShuffleSplit hold-out from the training fold. Also migrated to LightGBM 4 callbacks, dropped 1 row with NaN target, and reduced data copies to avoid OOM. Mean CV MAE is 0.0613 (no before/after comparison).
